EE.name: Express Entry – PR · اکسپرس انتری
EE.terms: Payment 1: 1,500 CAD at signing. Payment 2: balance after ITA. Or 4 instalments of 1,000 CAD: signing, +1 month, after ITA, before PR submission. Government fees extra.

PNP.name: PNP – non-Express Entry stream · PNP روش مستقیم
PNP.terms: Payment 1: 50% at signing. Payment 2: 50% after provincial nomination. Or 4 instalments of 1,000 CAD. Government fees extra.

PNP-EE.name: PNP – Express Entry stream · PNP روش اکسپرس انتری
PNP-EE.terms: Payment 1: 50% at signing. Payment 2: 50% after provincial nomination. Or 4 instalments: 1,000 / 1,000 / 1,000 / 1,500 CAD. Government fees extra.

SP-ADM.name: Admission + Study permit (college/university) · پذیرش و ویزای تحصیلی
SP-ADM.terms: 50% at signing (admission process starts). 50% after the original letter of acceptance. Opening offer 2,200 CAD; floor 1,800 CAD. Government fees extra.

SP-ADM-K12.name: Admission + Study permit (school student) · پذیرش و ویزای تحصیلی دانش آموزی
SP-ADM-K12.terms: 50% at signing. 50% after the original letter of acceptance. Government fees extra.

SP-ONLY.name: Study permit only (admission in hand) · فقط ویزای تحصیلی
SP-ONLY.terms: Full contract amount plus government fees at signing.

TRV.name: Visitor visa (TRV) · ویزای ویزیتوری
TRV.terms: Full contract amount plus government fees at signing.

BV.name: Business visitor visa · ویزای بیزنس ویزیتور
BV.terms: Full contract amount plus government fees at signing.

SUPERVISA.name: Parents' super visa · سوپر ویزای والدین
SUPERVISA.terms: Full contract amount plus government fees at signing.

OWP-ACC.name: Accompanying work permit (spouse/children of student or worker) · ورک پرمیت همراه
OWP-ACC.terms: Full contract amount plus government fees at signing.

IN-WP.name: In-Canada work permit (2025 update) · ورک پرمیت داخل کانادا
IN-WP.terms: Full contract amount plus government fees at signing.

IN-TRV.name: In-Canada visitor visa (TRV, permit holders) · ویزای توریستی داخل کانادا
IN-TRV.terms: Full contract amount plus government fees at signing.

VR.name: Visitor record · ویزیتور ریکورد
VR.terms: Full contract amount plus government fees at signing.

SPX.name: Study permit extension · تمدید اجازه تحصیل
SPX.terms: Full contract amount plus government fees at signing.

PGWP.name: Post-graduation work permit · اجازه کار پس از تحصیل
PGWP.terms: Full contract amount plus government fees at signing.

PERMIT-AMEND.name: Permit amendment in Canada · اصلاحیه پرمیت
PERMIT-AMEND.terms: Full contract amount at signing. No government fee.

RESTORE.name: Restoration of status (added to the permit service) · Restoration
RESTORE.terms: Full contract amount plus government fee at signing.

CAREGIVER.name: Caregiver – PR · پرستار خانگی
CAREGIVER.terms: Stage 1: 2,000 CAD at signing. Stage 2: balance when 2026 details are announced, before PR submission. 50% refund if we cannot submit. 2026 capacity: 5 contracts.

WP-ABROAD.name: Work permit from outside Canada · ورک پرمیت از خارج کانادا
WP-ABROAD.terms: 50% at signing, 50% before submission to IRCC.

PRC-RENEW.name: PR card renewal (no issues) · تمدید کارت اقامت دائم

PRC-LOST.name: Replacement of lost PR card · صدور مجدد کارت PR

CIT-LEGAL.name: Citizenship application with legal issue · شهروندی با مشکل قانونی

JR.name: Judicial review – refusal handled by us · Judicial Review
JR.terms: Full amount at signing. Federal Court work is done with PAX Law.

JR-REPEAT.name: Judicial review – second time on the same file · Judicial Review دوم
JR-REPEAT.terms: Full amount at signing. Federal Court work is done with PAX Law.

JR-EXT.name: Judicial review – refusal not handled by us · Judicial Review خارجی
JR-EXT.terms: Full amount at signing (2,500 PAX Law + 1,000 SugimotoVisa).

MANDAMUS.name: Mandamus (delay litigation) · مانداموس
MANDAMUS.terms: Stage 1: 750 CAD – demand letter. Stage 2: 1,750 CAD – Federal Court filing.

PR-RO.name: PR residency obligation · PR: Residency Obligation

PFL.name: Procedural fairness letter response · پاسخ به PFL
PFL.terms: Full amount at signing. Fixed at 3,000–5,000 CAD after reviewing the letter; payment plan available.

HC.name: Humanitarian & compassionate (in Canada) · روش بشر دوستانه H&C
HC.terms: 2,000 CAD at signing, 2,000 CAD after 3 months, 1,500 CAD after 6 months. Delivered by Parsay; coordinate with Mr Hossein.

REF.name: Refugee claim – without hearing · پناهندگی بدون دادگاه
REF.terms: 3,000 CAD at signing, 1,500 CAD after submission. Delivered by Parsay.

REF-HEAR.name: Refugee claim – with hearing · پناهندگی با دادگاه
REF-HEAR.terms: 3,000 CAD at signing, 1,500 CAD after submission, 2,000 CAD after the hearing notice. Delivered by Parsay.

LMIA.name: LMIA with employer · قرارداد LMIA
LMIA.terms: Full LMIA amount at signing. Work-permit contract starts after LMIA is issued.

LMIA-WP.name: Work permit under LMIA · ورک پرمیت LMIA
LMIA-WP.terms: 50% at signing, 50% before submission to IRCC. Government fees extra.

SPON-SPOUSE.name: Spousal / common-law sponsorship · اسپانسرشیپ همسر
SPON-SPOUSE.terms: 50% at signing, 50% before submission. Or 4 monthly instalments of 1,000 CAD.

PROV-CERT.name: Provincial certification – specific occupations · تایید استانی مشاغل خاص

TD-REF.name: Travel document – refugee · تراول داکیومنت Refugee

TD-PR.name: Travel document – PR · تراول داکیومنت PR
TD-PR.terms: Price not set in the price list.

DETENTION.name: Immigration / border detention · بازداشت مهاجرتی
DETENTION.terms: 3,000–9,000 CAD depending on the case; quote per file.

PRRA.name: Pre-removal risk assessment · PRRA
PRRA.terms: 3,000–9,000 CAD depending on the case; quote per file.
